notices.short_title: HWXPRATT - RECONSTRUCTION OF PRATT AVENUE RETAINING WALL, THE BRONX
notices.description: Responses to this CSB must be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal at the following website: https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. Click on the Search Funding Opportunities in PASSPort blue box. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the CSB, insert the EPIN (85027B0023) into the Keywords search field. Please note, this link is only for NON-PQL projects. For PQL projects, only certified vendors will receive the solicitations.
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction is seeking sealed bids, due Dec. 16, 2026, for reconstructing the Pratt Avenue retaining wall in the Bronx, with the lowest qualified bid to win.

The Department of Environmental Protection awarded the Water Environment Federation a $46,003 contract for membership services under the title BWT WEF Membership, with the selection method listed as "Other.

notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Department of Finance (DOF) to enter into sole source negotiations with IXP Corporation for the continuation of Mobile Data System (MDS) Gateway Maintenance and Support Services.

Any vendor, who is an authorized reseller for IXP Corporation that provide the MDS Gateway Maintenance and Support Services is invited to express its interest by submitting a response in PASSPort. Please complete the Acknowledgment tab and submit a response in the Manage Responses tab. If you have questions about the details of the RFx, please submit through the Discussion with Buyer tab.

Vendor resources and materials can be found at the link below under the Finding and Responding to RFx (Solicitation) heading:
https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/passport/getting-started-with-passport.page  

If you need additional assistance with PASSPort, please contact the MOCS Service Desk via:  https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8
(Click on Request Assistance)
notices.plain: The Department of Finance intends to negotiate a sole source contract with IXP Corporation to continue Mobile Data System Gateway maintenance and support services, and other authorized resellers may respond by Dec. 1, 2026.

notices.description: The New York State Office of Mental Health ('OMH') requires the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene ('DOHMH') to contract with Unique People Services to support the continuation of supportive housing services (23 beds) for The James Bryant Program located at 2027 Madison Avenue, New York NY 10035. To provide individuals with access to permanent and supportive affordable housing in New York City and to assist tenants by preventing homelessness, incarceration, and medical and psychiatric hospitalization. This is accomplished by helping the tenants develop skills for independent living, positive social connections, parenting, obtain benefits, develop vocational and educational skills, pursue employment, create linkages for health/mental health care, and, where possible, family reunification.
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Unique People Services Inc. a $6,746,524 contract, required by New York State's Office of Mental Health, to continue supportive housing services for 23 beds at The James Bryant Program on Madison Avenue in Manhattan.

PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Franchise and Concession Review Committee, will hold a public meeting, on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 2:30 P.M., at 255 Greenwich Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10007

For further information on accessibility or to make a request for accommodations, such as sign language interpretation services, please contact the Mayors Office of Contract Services (MOCS) via e-mail at DisabilityAffairs@mocs.nyc.gov or via phone at (212) 298-0734. Any person requiring reasonable accommodation for the public hearing should contact MOCS at least five (5) business days in advance of the hearing to ensure availability.
notices.plain: The Franchise and Concession Review Committee will hold a public meeting on Wednesday, Dec. 9, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. at 255 Greenwich Street, 8th Floor, in Manhattan.

notices.description:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, PURSUANT TO LAW, that the following revocable consent has been schedules for a public hearing by the New York City Department of Transportation. A draft copy of the revocable consent agreement(s) may be obtained at no cost by submitting a request at diningoutnyc.info/requestcopy

The public hearing will be held remotely via Zoom, commencing on December 10th, 2026, at 11:00 am, in the matter of a proposed revocable consent authorizing the following:

  1. 11TH STREET HOSPITALITY to maintain, operate, and use a year-round roadway cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 314 W 11 Street in the Borough of Manhattan.

  2. VILLAGE SQUARE PIZZA III INC to maintain, operate, and use a year-round roadway cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 1200 Lexington Avenue in the Borough of Manhattan.

  3. G.V.S. BAKERY INC to modify a license issued to maintain, operate and use a sidewalk cafe for a term of four years adjacent to 36-21 Ditmars Boulevard in the Borough of Queens.

To join the hearing enter the following URL link into your browsers address bar: zoom.us/j/91467302621 Meeting ID: 914 6730 2621
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation will hold a remote Zoom hearing at 11 a.m. Dec. 10, 2026, on proposed four-year roadway and sidewalk cafe consents for three businesses in Manhattan and Queens.

notices.description:
Notice of Intent to Issue New Solicitation(s) Not Included in FY 2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the mayor will be issuing the following solicitation(s) not included in the FY 2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule that is published pursuant to New York City Charter § 312(a):

Agency: DOHMH

Description of Services to be Provided: DOHMH is procuring a CPA firm to perform fiscal audits of Early Intervention (EI) providers that are identified as high risk based on a risk assessment methodology. 

Anticipated Contract Start Date: 4/01/2028

Anticipated Contract End Date: 3/31/2034

Anticipated Procurement Method: Task Order

Job titles: Assistant Commissioner, Admin Accountant, Admin Management Auditor, Management Auditor, Admin Staff Analyst, Admin Contract Specialist, Assistant Systems Analyst, Investigator (HMH), City Research Scientist, Cybersecurity Analyst, Certified IT LAN/WAN, Computer Systems Manager.

Headcount: 15
notices.plain: The Mayor's Office of Contract Services gives notice that the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) plans to hire a CPA firm to conduct fiscal audits of high-risk Early Intervention providers, under a task order running April 1, 2028, through March 31, 2034.
